description: Parking Citations is a series of datasets listed in City of Oakland open data portal (data.oaklandca.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Oakland. Parking citations in Oakland from 2018. Data has been cleaned of personal information but data entry errors still remain. Approximately ~89% of citation addresses matched when geocoded. Refer to Status and Score fields to determine estimated accuracy. Coverage: Oakland. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the category Public Services. Its tags are citations, parking. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Oakland Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2019-08-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oaklandca-gov-portal.
